name: douyin-influencer-ops
description: 抖音素人博主发现、筛选、复核与合作跟进平台。

scripts.legacy:import: npm run build -w @douyin/contracts && npm run build -w @douyin/platform-douyin && npm run build -w @douyin/domain && npm run legacy:import -w @douyin/domain --
scripts.build: npm run build -w @douyin/contracts && npm run build -w @douyin/platform-douyin && npm run build -w @douyin/domain && npm run build -w @douyin/api && npm run build -w @douyin/worker && npm run build -w @douyin/collector && npm run build -w @douyin/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @douyin/contracts && npm run build -w @douyin/platform-douyin && npm run build -w @douyin/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:local-env && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @douyin/domain && npm run migrate -w @douyin/domain
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
